[EN] I don't know how these people can expect to hold a festival while there's still so much trouble brewing. But, as long as they're all here, they're not getting into trouble out there.
[ES] No entiendo cómo esta gente puede pensar en celebrar un festival mientras aún hay tantos problemas gestándose. Pero, mientras estén todos aquí, no se meterán en problemas allá afuera.
